source.release_status: The audited commit is not contained in a tagged NEST release.
source.provenance_caveat: The independent authors describe the link to the LZ 2026 Letter as circumstantial and explicitly state that they have not established this is the exact build run by the collaboration.

nr_mean_yield.note: The code vector is the higher-precision EFT2024 header vector. Table S5 is the rounded published presentation. The final three entries are the high-energy p(E) extension parameters a, b, E0.

er_mean_yield.note: Index 5 is a sentinel in GetYieldBetaGR, not an ordinary fitted coefficient. A negative value activates the density/W-value correction branch; the public EFT2024 executable vector uses -1 while Table S3 prints 0. This difference must be retained and tested, not silently reconciled.

nr_relevant_zero_based_indices.2: negative recombination suppression parameter; GetQuanta sets lambdaChen=1+p[2]=0.293 for NR and RecombOmegaNR clips the negative omega to zero
nr_relevant_zero_based_indices.11: F_i slope versus mean ion number
nr_relevant_zero_based_indices.12: F_ex slope versus mean exciton number

er_relevant_zero_based_indices.6: ER Fano-like fluctuation coefficient; negative branch adds |p[6]| sqrt(Nq_mean) sqrt(Efield) to the base Fano factor
er_relevant_zero_based_indices.7: first skew-Gaussian amplitude input for RecombOmegaER

nr_er_fluctuation.implementation_note: Use NEST RecombOmegaER at the pinned commit. Its implementation normalizes each skew-Gaussian component; do not substitute the printed Supplemental Eq. (4) literally without checking the normalization convention.

ws2024_detector_configuration.note: The default LZ_Detector_2024 initialization in the audited header selects these WS2024 vectors.

generic_nest_defaults_at_541b643.note: These are generic upstream defaults, not LZ-fitted values. In controlled comparisons they are applied to the same LZ EFT2024 detector-response overrides so the yield/fluctuation model difference is isolated.

hepdata_status.caveat: The HEPData record JSON endpoint returned HTTP 403 in the retrieval workflow. The archive and its submission.yaml were inspected directly. The public NEST EFT2024 header is a separate source and must not be described as a file contained in the HEPData ZIP.
